extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: two tier birthday cake, 24 cm and 15 cm tiers, approx. 28 x 28 x 25 cm on its board
extras.notes: mint buttercream tier with colourful sugar confetti, pink tier with white dots, white piped shell borders, six twisted candles; flames are a separate emissive object ('birthday-cake_flames', not baked); rosettes and a strawberry on top; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
